ota.summary: Innovo RedBox Fury 2026.09.21.48 - ESPHome 2026.9.0. Captive portal rebased on current upstream (SSID JSON escaping, scan-results locking, NVS writes deferred off the HTTP thread, duplicate AP de-dup). Orbitron webfont embedded and served from the device so onboarding is branded without internet. 30-minute provisioning window closes the setup AP. Symmetric dual-OTA partition table on USB-flashed units.
